Skills, expertise and capabilities

I investigate customer problems, turn what I learn into strategy, shape product and conversational experiences, write the words, and help teams decide what to solve first.

  • Research and insight generation

    Finding out what is really going wrong, and why, before deciding what to change.

  • Copywriting and content development

    Clear words for every moment, from an error message to a campaign.

  • Customer experience and journey design

    Seeing the whole journey, not one screen, and removing friction where it starts.

  • Content strategy and governance

    The principles, structures and standards that let a whole team get it right.

  • Product thinking and roadmapping

    Deciding what needs solving, why it matters, what comes first, and how the solution grows.

  • Voice and conversational experiences

    Language for interfaces people talk to, and that talk back.

  • Leadership and cross-functional collaboration

    Getting content into the room early, and helping others do it well.

  • AI and emerging workflows

    Using AI where it helps, with people setting the rules and reviewing the output.

People I work with

Content decisions connect four kinds of input. These are the functions I work with on every project.

User needs

  • Researchers
  • Customer experience and support

What people are trying to do, and where they get stuck.

Product requirements

  • Product managers
  • Product and visual designers

What the product must do, and how it is structured.

Technical constraints

  • Engineering
  • QA

What can be built, named and maintained.

Business goals

  • Business owners
  • Marketing and sales

What the business needs to change, and how it will be measured.

Content design turns these inputs into the words, structure and rules a product can ship.
